coverage: All 16 voivodeships, 380 counties (314 powiats and 66 city-counties), and 2,479 gminas. Current PRG geometry and official 1 January 2026 population and area; 2024 regional GDP. Municipal geometry cleaned and simplified together at 2 metres; parent geometry dissolved from the same shared edges. City and rural gminas sharing a seat remain separate.
processing: Official PRG gmina geometry cleaned and simplified together at 2 metres, then dissolved by exact TERYT parents. All three levels share the same edges. Complete shared international arcs replace the neighboring display edges; mapped lagoon water is carved out separately. Detailed gmina geometry loads per selected county.
